entry.author: Te Hiringa Mahara
entry.summary:
Te Hiringa Mahara - Mental Health and Wellbeing Commission has published its first system performance monitoring report. 

This video provides a summary of the six shifts noted in the report to improve mental health & wellbeing outcomes in NZ Sign Language.  

Download the report here: https://www.mhwc.govt.nz/news-and-resources/system-performance-monitoring-report-2025/
